## Frequently Asked Questions
Four intersections with one approach per intersection are included in the one-year pilot.

If a car enters the intersection after the light has turned red, the camera system activates.

- It captures video footage and also takes several still photos— showing the vehicle entering the intersection on red, the driver's face, and the license plate.

Red light cameras capture video footage and also take several still photos— showing the vehicle entering the intersection on red, the driver, and the license plate.
